BiblicalUsage: lâqash means to gather the after crop, and its few appearances are all worth reading. In Job 24:6, "They reap [every one] his corn in the field: and they gather the vintage of the wicked.".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God sees the poor gathering what the fields leave behind, and He counts how the powerful treat them.
